title: GLASS Projector
body: Put the projector in a wall of [[extensions|GLASS Extensions]] (or on its own) and right-click it to choose a [[channels|channel]]. Give it a redstone signal and the screen builds itself out of the glass, starting at the projector.
Switching to another channel while it is on wipes the new picture over the old one. Taking the signal away switches it off.
The same screen also holds the [[cloak|cloak]] settings.
